INC-164  Add Gdansk to the port registry
status: open   priority: P3   area: ports   reported: 2026-08-03 by network-planning

We start calling at the Baltic Hub in Gdansk next month and planners cannot select it.
Please add it to the port registry: UN/LOCODE PLGDN, name Gdansk, country PL, time zone
Europe/Warsaw, maximum draft 15 m, pilotage 2 hours.

Acceptance:
  portByCode("PLGDN") returns Gdansk with country PL, timezone Europe/Warsaw, maxDraftM 15
  and pilotageHours 2, and portsInCountry("PL") lists both PLGDN and PLGDY.

Files:
  registry/ports.csv
  src/ports/registry.ts
